integration_wiring_2026_09_04.summary: Closed the loop between core modules: 016 validates → 021 selfHeals; 017 failures → 019 Planner steps
details: 016-hub-orchestrator: added healUnhealthy() — feeds registry errors into __NEXUS_FAILURE__.selfHeal() with init policy; wired into runCatalyst() so every catalyst cycle auto-heals unhealthy modules

017-self-evolution-engine: added planRecovery(failureType, context) — looks up FailureTypes config, builds task string, calls __NEXUS_CONSENSUS__.runConsensus() to get Planner steps + Researcher risks + Critic approval; returns structured recovery plan with retryHint
Both functions exported via window.__NEXUS_HUB__ and window.__NEXUS_EVOLUTION__ respectively

registry_autodiscovery_2026_09_04.summary: Extended 020-module-registry auto-discoverFromGlobals() — scans all __NEXUS_*Module__ globals + legacy MODULE_ID globals
details: Added discoverFromGlobals() — iterates window keys matching __NEXUS_*Module__ pattern, registers any unregistered modules
Also scans legacy MODULE_ID globals (old-style 01-Chat-Enhancement modules) and registers them with role 'automation' and category 'legacy'
Wired into init() — runs after scanExisting() on every startup
Exported via window.__NEXUS_REGISTRY__

recovery_to_registry_2026_09_04.summary: Closed the full recovery loop: 016 heal → 017 planRecovery → 020 recordRecoveryAction
details: 020-module-registry: added recordRecoveryAction(moduleName, plan) — stores recovery plan (failureType, category, steps, risks, confidence, retryHint) in module.recovery_history (cap 20), sets status RECOVERY_PLANNED, exported via __NEXUS_REGISTRY__

016-hub-orchestrator: healUnhealthy() upgraded — after selfHeal, calls __NEXUS_EVOLUTION__.planRecovery() to get consensus plan, then __NEXUS_REGISTRY__.recordRecoveryAction() to track it; passes modState.errorType to selfHeal; results include recovery_plan
Full loop: failure detection → self-heal retry → consensus-based recovery plan → registry-tracked action with full audit trail
